verdict.rationale: Resend offers a full REST API, SMTP interface, official CLI, and SDKs, all of which enable headless usage in CI/automation pipelines without any UI dependency; idempotency keys and API key scoping further support automated/scripted workflows. Missing for 10: no explicit CI-specific documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions integration guide) or independent hands-on report of running Resend in a CI pipeline.
